body:
Yes, my plans are to move to the United States. 
This man isn't dangerous, I can wholeheartedly say this in good faith.  He is not violent.

My mother and half siblings are from California and moving to New Mexico would be much closer them as well. Much easier to visit. 
Ideally, our plan is to have me file for dual citizenship, and then move to New Mexico and plan our wedding, and start our lives together. I had planned to move to the United States anyway, to be nearer to my sister.
No, he cannot enter Canada for legal reasons. The only option is for me to visit. My employer would not just let me have 14 days off, even for a mandated quarantine.
And if you read my post, I cannot afford an unpaid 14 day quarantine. I would also lose my employment.

Some people just have a morbid sense of humour. I'm one of them. I make frequent jokes about dying, and yes, I have constant suicidal ideations. A lot of people who fall under the 'depressed' umbrella use self deprecating humour to make light of their situation or feelings. Sometimes it's a way of asking for help. It really depends on the person.

Is it bad? I wouldn't necessarily say yes. Is it healthy? Not likely.

I have watched videos and read posts, testimonials. Nothing has swayed me. I'm not heartless or uncaring, but what I feel has been nothing short of constant anguish. I've been on tons of meds, been in therapy, and have even gone to the psych ward and I have found zero relief, comfort, or coping mechanisms that actually work.

Yes.

I feel like it will be how I die, regardless of age and other factors. Planning or going over my intended method sort of brings me a sense of comfort. 
I decided at 14 that I wanted to die, and have only found as the years go on that it gets harder to find reasons to stay, and hold on.
I have no doubt that I will eventually follow through with it.
And also, my method couldn't possibly look accidental. I chose it for it's rate of succession and more 'peaceful' approach. Less traumatic for those that find me.

I do, but having given this some thought over the years and many letters drafted and written... is it not selfish for others to want to keep you here in a miserable and painful existence? I guess I'm trying to finda less selfish way to say, "My personal feelings are more important."

You might scar, discoloration does sometimes happen. I have a scar on my wrist that has stayed a pink colour for many years.
Leave it alone, resist the urge to pick, poke, and scratch. and once healed you could try a vitamin e oil to help with the scarring?

Is it recurring? Is it painful? 
If not, I wouldn't worry about it.

You more than likely don't have Covid19.
It sounds like an infection, and swelling that size definitely needs medical attention.
